usedFor: A “New Case” in Advogalia saves a file into a Dropbox folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Case” in Advogalia, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A new case is when a document folder starts, and you choose add, replace or update.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” saves from a public web link, so the file must be reachable.
